# Greenwood Finlore

> Greenwood Finlore is an AI powered multi-asset trading platform for Bitcoin, Ethereum and 300+ markets, built for Australian investors. The platform combines AI signal scanning, copy trading and a learning library with bank grade security and 24/7 support.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://greenwoodfinlore-au.com/): The platform. AI signals, growth calculator, custody and support for Australian traders.
- [Product](https://greenwoodfinlore-au.com/product): Charts, signals, portfolio tracking and learning tools in one platform.
- [About Us](https://greenwoodfinlore-au.com/about-us): The story, values and principles behind Greenwood Finlore.
- [Contact Us](https://greenwoodfinlore-au.com/contact-us): Email support from real people, available 24/7.
- [FAQs](https://greenwoodfinlore-au.com/faq): Answers about accounts, security, assets, deposits and withdrawals.
- [Sign Up](https://greenwoodfinlore-au.com/sign-up): Create a free account in under two minutes.
